verdict.rationale: The evidence shows sensor-related capability in two places: Isaac Sim adds RTX and physics-based sensors (including stereo cameras) and bridges to ROS 2. Isaac ROS provides production-ready ROS 2 perception and localization packages that interoperate with standard ROS 2 tooling through NITROS. However, nothing documents ready-made drivers for physical cameras, lidars, IMUs, or GPS units, and the sensor support shown is largely simulated rather than hardware bring-up. Missing for 10: documented hardware drivers for cameras/lidars/IMUs/GPS, explicit standard message-type coverage per sensor class, any IMU or GPS mention, and independent hands-on corroboration.
